newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan tenders to buy Jan-Mar '97 oil products.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders to buy Jan-Mar '97 oil products.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has issued a tender to buy 826,200 tonnes of oil products for January-March 1997 deliveries, a ministry official said on Thursday.
This is 91,000 tonnes more than the 735,000 tonnes that it bought in the last tender for October-December 1996 deliveries.
The volume could be even more if Pakistan decided to take the 300,000 tonnes of optional cargoes it is requesting as part of the first quarter 1997 tender.
The tender closes on December 5 and offers will be valid until December 12, he said.

"We have issued this tender because we have immediate requirements for the first quarter," the official told Reuters by telephone. "But this does not mean that we have finalised the import policy under the interim oil minister. The matter is still under review."

The official said on November 7 that the interim oil minister, Javed Jabbar who replaces Anwar Saifullah, will have to be briefed on current policies and they will have to decide whether or not new directions for imports have to be taken.
The new petroleum and natural resources minister was appointed under a caretaker government after President Farooq Leghari appinted sacked Benazir Bhutto as Prime Minister early this month.

The official had said that issues under review include the country's import policy--whether to continue with the current method of importing 75 percent of its oil products by term contracts and 25 percent by quarterly tenders, or to import 100 percent by term contracts.

The official said the first quarter tender seeks 1.0-percent sulphur diesel, 80-octane leaded gasoline, aviation gasoline, 125-centistoke grade fuel oil and furnace oil with a 3.5-percent and 1.0-percent sulphur content.
Diesel, motor and aviation gasoline are for delivery to Keamari while the fuel oil and furnace oil cargoes are for delivery to Fotco and Keamari on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
